title: Exactness of the concrete open direct-image Mayer-Vietoris diagram
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let U,V be opens with U union V=X, and let I be any cochain complex of O_X-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with every term I^n injective. Then the explicitly constructed short complex S(X,U,V,I) of [def-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-data] is short exact: its first arrow is monic, its second arrow is epic, and the image of the first is the kernel of the second. K-injectivity and the existence of derived categories are not assumed.

source.place: Lemma 20.33.2 (Tag 08BV, lemma-exact-sequence-j-star), displayed direct-image sequence and proof

proof.text: On degree n sections over a test open T, identify the fixed units with restrictions I^n(T) -> I^n(T intersection U) and I^n(T intersection V). Transpose the fixed overlap map along the underived adjunction: alpha inverse restricts twice, the restricted counit removes the extra U restriction, and alpha identifies the result with restriction to the smaller open. Thus g is the difference of the two ordinary restriction maps.

Since U and V cover X, T intersection U and T intersection V cover T. Sheaf uniqueness makes f injective on sections; sheaf gluing makes its image exactly the kernel of the difference map. Given an intersection section, lift it along T intersection U intersection V contained in T intersection U using injective_restriction_surjective for I^n and use zero in the V component. Thus g is sectionwise surjective.

The sectionwise kernel calculation is a kernel universal property of presheaf modules, and it remains a kernel universal property of sheaves by full faithfulness. Sectionwise injectivity makes f monic and sectionwise surjectivity makes g epic. Apply HomologicalComplex.shortExact_of_degreewise_shortExact to conclude short exactness of the complex diagram.
